name: Ara
source:
Hobby: Observing life
Job: Fortune Teller

The mysterious Fortune Teller who enjoys telling everyone their misfortune. In OASE, Ara can be found in the Shopping Mall with Asta. She will help you with Fortune Telling. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
